notes: Occasions as data — runtime/occasion_engine.py resolves these daily; nothing duck- or occasion-specific is hardcoded in flows. rule.type: 'fixed' (month/day) or 'nth_weekday' (month, weekday 0=Mon..6=Sun, nth). lead_days: how many days before the peak the occasion becomes active. keywords: lowercase substrings matched against product tags (supporting signal — the primary signal is theme_classification.occasions from Surface 12). recipients: theme_classification recipient ids that boost a product. messaging_phases: first entry whose max_days_until_peak >= days_until_peak wins, ordered ascending.
